استقدرت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْدَرْتُ (istaqdartu) /is.taq.dar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اِسْتَقْدَرْتَ (istaqdarta) /is.taq.dar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اِسْتَقْدَرْتِ (istaqdarti) /is.taq.dar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقْدَرَ (istaqdara)
# اِسْتَقْدَرَتْ (istaqdarat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
